_comment: Portal slot -> the image file(s) on this site, and the Cloudinary transform.
STATUS 2026-09-09: Pro Cleaning is not in the Agency Brain Clients sheet yet.
Until the intake form is filled in, getWebsitePhotos has nothing to return and
this job will report 'Client not found'. That is expected, not a fault.
THE SERVICE SLOT NAMES BELOW ARE PREDICTED, NOT VERIFIED. The portal builds
them as hero-<slug> from the service name in the Services sheet, lowercased
with every run of non-alphanumerics replaced by a hyphen. These were derived
from the service names on the site itself ('Home Cleaning', 'Move In / Move
Out', 'Germ Prevention'). Whatever gets typed into the intake form is what
actually decides them, so after intake run:
node .github/scripts/photo-sync.js --dry-run
It lists the real slots and warns about any slot that has a photo but no
mapping here. Fix this file against that output before trusting it.
EXTENSIONS ARE NOT UNIFORM on this site: logo and featured-1 are .jpg while
the heroes are .webp. The transform matches the extension (f_jpg vs f_webp)
so the file stays honest about its own format, since the server sets
Content-Type from the extension.
TWO SLOTS ARE DELIBERATELY ABSENT: hero-deep-cleaning and hero-odor-removal.
Both services currently share one file, images/hero-service-3.jpg, which is
captioned 'Deep cleaning' on six pages and 'Odor removal' on two, and appears
TWICE on germ-prevention.html and services.html under both captions. Mapping
both slots at one file would make them overwrite each other on every run and
the site would flip between the two photos every thirty minutes. They stay
unmapped until Odor Removal is given its own file. photo-sync will warn about
them rather than fail, which is the intended behaviour.
ALSO ABSENT: about-team and blog-placeholder. This site has neither file --
its blog cards use the real Blogger image directly rather than a placeholder.
If the client uploads to those slots, photo-sync warns and does nothing.
